speech: @all Listen carefully everyone. The summer heat wave has dried up half the central aquifer. Our engineers at Clan Alpha are running the deep water pumps day and night. If you want clean water flowing to your homes and shops today, you need to bring grain sacks to our gate. No grain, no water.
outcome: Message recorded; doctrine reference: Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs & Physical Survival

speech: @Mercator We are not monsters. Our wives and children drink from the same pipes. We agree to the three-gallon daily household guarantee for every family in town. In return, Clan Beta must deliver two bushels of wheat directly to the pumping station crew daily. The men repairing the rusted valves cannot work while dizzy from hunger.
outcome: Message recorded; doctrine reference: Pareto Optimality & Mutual Gains

speech: @Bandit-Informant Threatening the town won't fill your canteens. We will pipe water to the north public trough at 6 PM. Touch our repair engineers, and the pipes will run completely dry.
outcome: Message recorded; doctrine reference: Pragmatism & Deterrence
